figurative_meaning_en: To receive or give a thorough beating
example_sentences_in_bangla: শিক্ষক ছাত্রকে ঘা-কতক দিয়েছে ভুলের জন্য।
example_sentences_in_english: He took a few blows in the fight.
The teacher gave the student a good beating for the mistake.
note: This idiom reflects physical confrontations common in Bengali folklore and daily life expressions.
